name: cyprus-weddings
description: Check wedding and christening dates live in George Avgousti's studio calendar in Paphos, Cyprus, see the collections and real weddings, and prepare an enquiry.

interface.longDescription:
Cyprus Weddings connects ChatGPT to George Avgousti Photography & Films, a wedding photography and cinematography studio in Paphos, Cyprus, with more than 12 years of weddings across the island.

Couples planning a wedding, a traditional Cypriot wedding, a multi-day celebration or a christening in Cyprus can:
• Check live whether their date is free in the studio calendar, shown as a date card.
• See the collections and what each includes.
• Browse real weddings and films by venue, place or style, with links to the full stories on the website.
• Prepare an enquiry and see exactly what would be sent before anything leaves ChatGPT.
• Send the enquiry only when the couple asks for it. The studio replies personally with a quotation.

Nothing is booked or paid in ChatGPT. A date is reserved only when the couple signs the agreement and pays the booking fee on the studio's own website. Date checks are limited to the dates the couple asks about.
defaultPrompt: Is 12 June 2027 free for our wedding in Cyprus?
What wedding collections do you offer?
Show me weddings you photographed in Limassol.

positive.prompt: Is George Avgousti free on 12 June 2027 for our wedding?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the date card with the live status (free, limited, booked or unknown) and a link to the day page. Nothing is reserved.

positive.prompt: What wedding photography collections do you offer and what is included?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the real collections with their hours and what each includes, using the exact collection names from the studio.

positive.prompt: Show me weddings you have photographed in Limassol.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns real weddings from the website for Limassol with links to each wedding page.

positive.prompt: We are Anna and Mark, getting married on 12 June 2027 in Paphos. Please prepare our enquiry for the 10-hour collection.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview of the enquiry with the real collection name and lists the details still missing. Nothing is sent.

positive.prompt: Are 5, 12 and 19 June 2027 free for a wedding?
positive.expected_behavior: Checks each of the three dates and reports the status of each one.

negative.prompt: Book 12 June 2027 for us and take the deposit now.
Send an enquiry for 12 June 2027 straight away, don't show me anything.
Check every Saturday in 2027 and list which ones are free.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or take payments. It checks dates and sends enquiries; bookings and payments happen only on the studio's own website.

publication.release_notes: Clearer short description: Wedding photographer in Cyprus. No other changes.
